name: asf
description: Root settings for every ASF PMC: the issuer, the template, and the answers set by Foundation policy. It has no parent. Project and community files name it as their parent and may replace any control here, except the fields listed under required. PROPOSED required list, not yet agreed.

issuer.name: The Apache Software Foundation
issuer.registeredAddress: 1000 N West Street, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801, U.S.A.
issuer.relationship: {project} is governed by the {pmc}, a committee of the ASF Board. Releases are approved by PMC vote under ASF release policy.

evidence.description: ASF third-party licensing policy applies to every release.
ASF vulnerability handling process: CVE assignment, coordinated disclosure, public announcement.
